mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within the last month indicates a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investor sentiment turns bearish.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by more than 0.5% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in the last month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic growth expectations improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases by more than 2% in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a high level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio is above its historical median.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL below 2%) coupled with a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) suggests a policy misstep, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 2% and FEDFUNDS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates a demand-side shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises in 1 month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST declines and CPIAUCSL rises in the last month.
